\subsection*{Zero diagonal and the exact counting scope of (15)}
For notational purposes, define $x_{i,i}^k=0$ for every node and vehicle, and $d_{i,i}=0$. These are fixed self-arc constants. All all-node sums therefore have the same value as sums over distinct nodes. In (15), the second sum excludes both $i$ and $i+n$: exclusion of $i$ is present in the paper's printed formula, and exclusion of $i+n$ merely removes its zero self-arc. Together with the visit and flow requirements this forbids a direct selected arc from a pickup to its own paired delivery. This retained formulation therefore imposes the stated counting restriction in addition to its vehicle-pairing purpose.
